checks.name: ohlcv backfill over eight pages (since-cursor)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT ts), CAST(min(ts) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(ts) AS VARCHAR), sum(volume) FROM ccxt.main.ohlcv('binance', 'BTC/USDT', '1h', since := TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', until := TIMESTAMP '2024-01-31')

checks.name: ohlcv values
checks.sql: SELECT open, high, low, close, volume FROM ccxt.main.ohlcv('binance', 'BTC/USDT', '1d', since := DATE '2024-01-01', until := DATE '2024-01-04') ORDER BY ts

checks.name: ohlcv terminates when the exchange ignores since
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT ts) FROM ccxt.main.ohlcv('kraken', 'BTC/USD', '1h', since := TIMESTAMP '2024-02-26')

checks.name: trades keep fills sharing a millisecond across pages
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id), sum(amount) FROM ccxt.main.trades('binance', 'BTC/USDT', since := TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', until := TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 02:00:00')

checks.name: trades on an exchange that needs until (windowed)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM ccxt.main.trades('coinbase', 'BTC/USD', since := TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', until := TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 03:00:00')

checks.name: funding history: interval change and annualization
checks.sql: SELECT CAST(ts AS VARCHAR), funding_rate, interval_hours, round(funding_rate_annualized, 6) FROM ccxt.main.funding_rates('binance', 'BTC/USDT:USDT', start_date := TIMESTAMP '2024-01-31 16:00:00', end_date := TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01 09:00:00') ORDER BY ts

checks.name: ticker fan-out with per-exchange errors
checks.sql: SELECT exchange, last, error IS NULL FROM ccxt.main.ticker(['binance', 'coinbase', 'kraken', 'okx'], 'BTC/USDT') ORDER BY exchange

checks.name: current funding and open interest
checks.sql: SELECT f.exchange, f.funding_rate, f.interval_hours, o.open_interest_amount FROM ccxt.main.funding_rate(['binance', 'okx'], 'BTC/USDT:USDT') f JOIN ccxt.main.open_interest(['binance', 'okx'], 'BTC/USDT:USDT') o USING (exchange) ORDER BY f.exchange

checks.name: order book levels
checks.sql: SELECT side, level, price, amount FROM ccxt.main.order_book('kraken', 'BTC/USD', depth := 2) ORDER BY side DESC, level

checks.name: markets stream in several batches
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT symbol), count(*) FILTER (WHERE contract) FROM ccxt.main.markets('binance')

checks.name: has: capabilities and private methods never exposed
checks.sql: SELECT method, supported, exposed_by_worker FROM ccxt.main.has('binance') WHERE method IN ('createOrder', 'fetchBalance', 'fetchFundingRateHistory', 'withdraw') ORDER BY method

checks.name: exchanges table
checks.sql: SELECT id, has_funding_rate_history FROM ccxt.main.exchanges ORDER BY id
